Sentiment was helped by oil prices, which dropped in early trading as concerns eased over disruptions to Saudi pipeline flows and hopes grew for diplomatic talks between U.S. President Donald Trump and Gulf leaders on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York this week.
